heroSection.title: Proclaiming the light of life in Addis Ababa
heroSection.subtitle: A welcoming Christian family gathering to worship God, hear His Word, and grow together in faith. There is room for you here.
heroSection.verseText: I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.
heroSection.translationNote: English & Amharic fellowship translation always available for international guests

schedule.title: Weekly Service Schedules
schedule.description: Join us in praise, study, prayer, and intercession throughout the week at our main sanctuary auditorium in Summit.
schedule.sundayDesc: Corporate praise, communion thanksgiving, inspired biblical preaching, and Sunday school for all children classes.
schedule.thursdayDesc: Deep dive into scriptures with verse-by-verse exposition followed by intentional pastoral prayer and healing intercession.
schedule.saturdayDesc: Vibrant worship preparation, teen and college student discussions, contemporary acoustic hymns, and communal tea time.
